title: Blind 'psychic' Baba Vanga's prophecy warns humanity is on brink of a terrifying change - World News - News
excerpt: Baba Vanga, the blind Bulgarian psychic died 30 years ago but allegedly warned of a mysterious disease or genetic experiment that would result in people displaying 'superhuman-like' traits.
content:
Vanga warned of a mysterious disease or genetic experiment (Image: Default)

A famous blind psychic who was credited by her followers for allegedly predicting 9/11 and COVID-19 has now been linked for a prediction for 2027.

Baba Vanga, the blind Bulgarian psychic died 30 years ago but allegedly warned of a mysterious disease or genetic experiment that would result in people displaying "superhuman-like" traits. The prophecy, not backed by science, doesn't add details of the traits or how the transformation would occur.

A report by The Daily Mail and LadBible claim the psychic made the prediction for 2027.

The report suggested the prediction states only some would be affected by the biological changes after being exposed to some form of genetic experimentation or new disease.

The prophecy doesn't explain any further, whether the new traits mean enhanced strength or intelligence.

  • Psychic that 'predicted 2026 war' tips two countries for World Cup glory
  • Ex-CIA psychic spy claims he found alien bases with UFO repair shops

The late psychic did not leave any written records of her predictions and most of the accounts come from her neice, Krasimira Stoyanova, or other followers. Her predictions were allegedly documented by the followers and the neice however there have been accusations of misinterpretation of what Vanga said.

Vanga was born in 1911 as Vangeliya Pandeva Dimitrova and rose to fame as a blind psychic, clairvoyant and herbalist.
